newsitem.title: USA: Associates National Bank buys portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Associates National Bank buys portfolio.

text.p: The Associates National Bank said Wednesday it has purchased bank card receivables of about $800 million encompassing 825,000 accounts from The Bank of New York.
Associates National Bank, based in Wilmington, Delaware, said it is a top issuer of bank and private label credit cards and is a subsidiary of Associates First Capital Corp, based in Dallas.
About 140 Bank of New York employees will be hired by The Associates and remain at their current location in Newark, Delaware, The Associates said.
The Associates said it agreed to assume a portion of the lease at that location and will establish an additional customer service and collection center to service the accounts.
